71: That he went into exile on his own: Since it was not written, "Who had been from the group that was carried into exile," but [rather] written, "Who had been exiled with the group that was carried into exile" - it is implied that he was not like the rest of Israel, who were exiled against their will. But he went into exile on his own, like Yirmiyah did. For [the latter] went into exile on his own, until the Holy One, blessed be He, told him to return.
